Aftermath ESP

[+] Player ESP (Boxes, Names, Distance, Health Bars)
[+] Target Inspect HUD (Aim at player to see equipped gun & health)
[+] Zombie & Car ESP (With occupancy indicator)
[+] Ground Weapon & Loot ESP (High/Low Tier, auto-hides looted spawns)
[+] Airdrop & Airplane ESP (Live flight & crate tracking)
[+] Clickable In-Game Menu (F6 to open & toggle with mouse)

Keybinds:
• [F6] Menu & Cursor Toggle
• [RightShift] Master On/Off
